parts.text: Out of the 150 teachers on the school basketball court, 60% are history teachers and 10% are English teachers.
If the rest of the teachers on the court are math teachers, and each teacher sleeps for 6 hours a day, calculate the total time the math teachers collectively spend sleeping in one day.

parts.text: Jaime is a computer programmer for a company that currently has employed 100 people.
Senior programmers are paid $400 more than junior programmers.
The number of Junior programmers is 2/5 of the total number of employees, and they are each paid $2000 per month.
Now, consider that the company decides to give a 10% raise to all senior programmers, and calculate the total amount of money the company pays to all the programmers per month.

parts.text: While on holiday, John chooses to engage in a variety of activities.
He dedicates 6 hours to boating and spends half of that duration swimming.
He also views 3 shows, each lasting 2 hours.
This accounts for 30% of his total time.
He allocates 40% of his total time to exploring various sights.
Can you calculate the total time John spent sightseeing?

parts.text: Coach brought one bag filled with basketballs to practice and dumped them all out onto the gym floor before practice began.
After the practice time was over, he asked Jordan, Jason, and Jeffrey to pick up the balls and carry them over to the bag.
The three boys picked up and carried all of the balls in one trip.
Jordan carried twice as many balls as Jason, and Jason carried twice as many balls as Jeffrey.
If Jason had picked up and carried 200 balls, what is the total number of balls that the coach brought to practice?
